root_cause.mechanism: The commit replaced `pkgutil.get_loader` with `importlib.util.find_spec`. When running a script directly, `__name__` is `"__main__"`. If `sys.modules["__main__"].__spec__` is `None` (which is common when running scripts directly), `importlib.util.find_spec("__main__")` raises `ValueError: __main__.__spec__ is None`. This caused `Flask(__name__)` to fail during initialization.
